image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tiger beetle resting on a textured, earthy surface (soil/leaf litter). The beetle exhibits characteristic metallic green and bronze coloration with distinct pale, cream-colored markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes, and long, slender legs are visible gripping the substrate. Antennae are present but partially blend with the background.
